android_mechanism: Suggestions materialize all matching history rows instead of a bounded recent subset
bug_description: WebPage.onTitleReceive serializes the ENTIRE browsing-history list with JSON.stringify(list.map(...)) twice (before and after every recorded page visit), and HistoryPage.aboutToAppear stringifies the whole list again when the history page opens. With a large history this materializes and stringifies hundreds of entries on every page-load title event, blocking the web page load path and the history page transition.
fix_summary: The debug logs report the list size only, removing full-list map + JSON.stringify on the page-load and page-open paths.
trigger_steps: Seed a large history: open ~100 distinct articles from the home list (each open records one history entry).
Start hitrace capture (categories: ace, app, sched).
Stop hitrace. Repeat 3 repetitions for unfixed, then install the fixed HAP and repeat 3 repetitions.

test_oracle.definition: CPU time consumed in onTitleReceive handlers per page open (bounded by onTitleReceive to onPageEnd interval in trace), averaged over 10 opens.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed spends O(history_size) in JSON serialization per open (grows with history); fixed is O(1). With 100+ entries unfixed > fixed by >= 30% on the title-event path.

trace_config.command: hdc shell hitrace --time 30 ace app sched -o /data/local/tmp/wan_histlog.chtrace
